title: Talented rapper, Kala Drops new track “Flying Too Close To The Sun”
htmlContent:
Emerging music rapper Kala is a name worth mentioning in the music scene. He is a talented rapper, producer and songwriter who has made a name for himself with his flows and sounds. His talents are displayed in his recent track “Flying Too Close To The Sun.”

Everything is in full bloom in this track, from his raw lyrics to his fantastic sound that instantly grabs your attention. Kala “ Flying Too Close To The Sun” talks about how dreams burn out due to a lack of patience. The track embodies the feeling of wanting something so badly that you overwork yourself to rush things instead of trusting the process.
